name: ClydeCargoSteamerHull
notes: No named 1869 Clyde cargo steamer with a printed register tonnage was found. Bridge: 1,616.2 t capacity x 1.6 = 2,585.9, rounded to 2,586 GT; report 56 cargo band 0.8-2.3, n = 5. name: HandysizeBulk

notes: No 20,000 dwt bulker with a published register figure was found, so the figure is the gross-tonnage-to-deadweight ratio of two registered handysize bulkers: Christina (2011) 20,969 GT on 32,573 dwt = 0.644; Tuloma (1984) 18,259 GT on 29,785 dwt = 0.613. Mean 0.629 x 20,000 t = 12,580, rounded to 12,600 GT. The figure is the hull's, so every 480-20,000 t cargo fit carries it. Report 56's 1.6 cargo ratio is not used because a bulker's GT/dwt is 0.6, not 1.6.
